title: React destroys our HTML structure by inserting a lot of divs
body:
Especially on hit lists or refined lists, there are a lot of `<div>`s wrapped around `<li>` and `<a>` elements. This destroys the formatting of Bootstrap that heavily relays also on a somehow semantic HTML structure for several layout elements like lists. For example, Bootstrap uses a `.nav-list > li > a` styling that is fully destroyed by those React divs.

[I've read in the docs that jQuery is supported for custom widgets](https://github.com/instantsearch/instantsearch-jQuery-widget)...

It is unclear for me how/or what exactly is different when using jQuery, is it possible to avoid React as "renderer" at all or only for custom widgets?

This is related to http://stackoverflow.com/a/34517968/22470
